extra.tag: Best for unlimited cashback on all spend with no restrictions
extra.description: The OCBC INFINITY Cashback Credit Card is a fuss-free unlimited cashback card that allows you to earn 1.6% cashback on both local and foreign currency. Like other unlimited cashback cards, there is no minimum spend or cap. All cashback earned will be automatically credited to your OCBC INFINITY card account.
